agreement.section-1.text:
Section 1 - Services and fees
The Customer, Fictional Cedar Unicode near number Cooperative, engages the fictional Supplier to provide training logistics for one initial year. The Supplier will maintain a monthly work log and deliver a quarterly progress note. The service fee is 240 fictional units per month; milestone dates are planning estimates and do not alter exit or billing rights.
agreement.section-1.title: Services and fees

agreement.section-2.text:
Section 2 - Renewal
After the initial year, a further service period exists only if both parties expressly consent in a signed writing.
agreement.section-2.title: Renewal

agreement.section-3.text:
Section 3 - Termination
The Customer can leave this arrangement without stating a cause by delivering written notice thirty calendar days before exit.
agreement.section-3.title: Termination

agreement.section-4.text:
Section 4 - Payment
Undisputed invoices mature twelve calendar days after receipt by the Customer.
agreement.section-4.title: Payment

agreement.section-5.text:
Section 5 - Confidentiality
Each party limits access to the other's fictional operational records to staff performing the services. Public catalogue descriptions are excluded. Return of a sample record does not discharge an unpaid invoice or change the notice procedure.
agreement.section-5.title: Confidentiality

agreement.section-6.text:
Section 6 - Delivery and responsibility
The Supplier supplies a monthly export and corrects a missing row within seven working days. The Customer designates a contact for service questions. No service-level remedy changes the separate convenience or renewal terms.
agreement.section-6.title: Delivery and responsibility

agreement.section-7.text:
Section 7 - Definitions and reporting
A reporting month is the calendar month used in the work log. The log's closing date is not a contractual invoice trigger.
agreement.section-7.title: Definitions and reporting

agreement.section-8.text:
Section 8 - Records and entire arrangement
Fictional badge 🧮 Café remains intact. Twelve support alerts and sixty renewal reminders are operational counters, not contractual deadlines.
agreement.section-8.title: Records and entire arrangement
